## 📝 Report Naming Convention

All comprehensive reports now follow this pattern:

```
outcomes/sr_quality_datadriven_training_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.md
```

Example:
- `sr_quality_datadriven_training_20251102_200943.md` = Nov 2, 2025 at 20:09:43
